title: Rhubarb Crème Brûlée
method: Heat double cream and vanilla to near boil; remove and infuse 20 mins.
Whisk eggs with 28g caster sugar; slowly pour in hot cream, then cook over low heat stirring constantly to 88°C.
Strain custard through sieve and cover surface with parchment.
Simmer rhubarb with remaining sugar, orange zest, and juice until thick compote; spread into dish.
Blend cooled custard smooth, layer over rhubarb, and chill 4 hours.
Scatter demerara sugar on top and caramelise with a blowtorch.
